Activation Condition: When the user’s Trainer uses any moves 1 time.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time its sync move is used each battle. Powers up the sync moves of all allied sync pairs when the zone is a Bug Zone.
